title: Crooked Witch WALK v12 | rear skirt lining

Boots, cuff, knees, shin curves, heels and toes are in exactly the same positions as in the pose reference. The near RIGHT leg still occludes the far LEFT leg where the existing pose overlaps.

Preserve the exact character identity, body height, head size, shoulder width, limb proportions, weapon size, camera distance, ground line and lighting as in IMAGE 1. No resizing, stretching, mirroring or cropping. The same near RIGHT hand wraps around the same staff at the same location, empty left hand behind at the far hip, unbroken shaft in front of both legs and the skirt. No interpenetration, merged limbs, floating pieces or extra objects. No other changes to the sprite. Output one 1254x1254 RGBA image.
